title: Various Committees On Poverty And Employment
definition: A systematic evolution of expert groups and committees appointed by the Government of India since independence to define, measure, and estimate poverty lines, alongside tracking employment patterns.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (Committee names, chairpersons, calorie norms, expenditure metrics) and Mains GS-3 (Inclusive growth, poverty alleviation strategies, employment dynamics, inequality).
learningOutcomes: Master chronological timeline, chairpersons, and methodologies of all major poverty and employment committees.
Compare nutritional versus comprehensive consumption expenditure approaches.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to eliminate incorrect Prelims options effortlessly.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of National Sample Survey Office (NSSO) consumer expenditure surveys.
